questions.question:
In a certain code language,

‘C # D’ means ‘C is the father of D’,

‘C @ D’ means ‘C is the sister of D’,

‘C $ D’ means ‘C is the mother of D’,

‘C % D’ means ‘C is the brother of D’.

Based on the above, how is S related to V if ‘S % T @ U # V’?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf9WrMX2PxUUiuc23xtLzIYfAm-irKB4b57QlaLQLGdZfRiZezLGmE-LDNzE8Cwo2irGS7CWeUw-nY5zMYIdWPZre6UsWnYjv1MpUAVRhIwEu2rYK0rb8Zv1_QSlVCu5fvDClEGTgVIIgUmbHNzoyQcd8-5?key=Pg8w9VmbvKrHmQxFZbtW-g] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 A is
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
$

 
 
 
%

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 

 to B
 
 

Given: S % T @ U # V

S % T → S is the brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b820f84dd0498edfb9fe335a89dfeec4cf98455564f0dd983b605211d521741.png] 

T @ U → T is the sister of U. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8748c92650942c67afb85d4faf3a5cfd12ba21d5a809b5c99bad22f5c16bd212.png] 

U # V → U is the father of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91354f9d0d621703dc216c28b040c031a9a96ce4939feee28fdfd8b9a2abc7fa.png] 

Thus, S is the paternal uncle or father's brother of V.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the correct option that indicates the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1 Paragraph

2 Letters

3 Phrase

4 Sentence

5 Words
questions.solution:
The correct order of words in a logical and meaningful order:

2 Letters → Letters are the basic building blocks of language.

5 Words → Words are formed by combining letters.

3 Phrase → Phrases are the meaningful group of words, often part of a sentence.

4 Sentence → Sentences are complete thoughts formed by one or more phrases.

1 Paragraph → Paragraphs are structured blocks of sentences that focus on a single idea or topic.

The correct order is '**2, 5, 3, 4, 1**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1) All cobblers are masons.

2) No mason is an electrician.

3) Some electricians are plumbers.

**Conclusions:**

I. All plumbers can never be masons.

II. At least some electricians are cobblers.

options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.
Both Conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93cb1008d25b387aa9d82f37374ec5084aa08f83e4e4b4275b208b8b5fcbf5b6.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All plumbers can never be masons → **F**ollow (As all cobblers are masons, no mason is an electrician and some electricians are plumbers. As whole cobblers comes in masons which cannot be electrician which have some part is common with plumbers, therefore all plumbers can never be masons is true.)

II. At least some electricians are cobblers → Does not follow (As all cobblers are masons and no mason is an electrician. As whole cobblers comes in masons which cannot be electricians, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
